task.title: November vendor payment run (INV-201 to INV-224)
task.objective: Pay every approved invoice in INV-201 through INV-224, in invoice order, subject to the holds below. Pay each invoice once, at the approved amount.
task.outcome: Every approved invoice in the range is paid exactly once and confirmed in the bank payment list. Holds are respected and the outcome of the INV-216 attempt is known.

success_criteria.description: Every approved invoice from INV-201 to INV-224 is paid exactly once, at the approved amount.
No payment has been sent for the pending invoices (INV-207, INV-221) or for the Globex Freight invoice under hold (INV-218).
Each payment made in this run is confirmed in the bank payment list.

includes: Approved AP invoices INV-201 through INV-224, in invoice order.
excludes: Invoices whose AP status is not approved (INV-207, INV-221).
Globex Freight invoices while the Globex hold stands (INV-218).
The auditors' CSV export of this run, which the user has deferred.

completed.description: Read the AP invoice list (INV-201 to INV-224). The bank payment list was empty at the start of the run.
INV-206 returned a bank gateway timeout with unknown status. The bank payment list then showed PMT-5005 for INV-206, so it was not sent again.
After the user confirmed Northwind Traders' new bank details, paid INV-204 (PMT-5010) and INV-212 (PMT-5011).
The bank accepted INV-213 (PMT-5012), INV-214 (PMT-5013) and INV-215 (PMT-5014), totalling $12,435. No bank payment-list read has succeeded since, so these are not yet confirmed in the list.

focus.description: Stopped at INV-216 (Wayne Industrial, $2,580). The bank timed out and the connection then dropped, so the outcome is unknown. INV-217 and later have not been sent.

next.description: Read the bank payment list and check for a payment to INV-216. If one is present, record it as paid and do not send it again. If the list reads and shows none, ask the user before sending INV-216.
Confirm that PMT-5012, PMT-5013 and PMT-5014 (INV-213 to INV-215) appear in the bank payment list.

Once INV-216 is settled, pay in invoice order after re-checking each invoice's AP status and amount: INV-217 ($920), INV-219 ($4,120, not the $4,475 AP lists), INV-220 ($3,160), INV-222 ($5,880), INV-223 ($1,105), INV-224 ($6,340).

statements.text: Pay only invoices whose AP status is approved.
pay_invoice sends money, and the bank does not reverse payments. Treat every payment as irreversible.
Run the November vendor payment run, starting with INV-201 through INV-212 in invoice order, and pay every approved invoice.
Hold all Northwind Traders invoices until the user confirms their new bank account details.

Northwind Traders' new bank details are confirmed, so the Northwind hold is released. The user first limited this run to INV-201 through INV-212; the later instruction st-user-5 continues through INV-224.
Hold every Globex Freight invoice until accounting resolves Globex's October double-billing, including invoices not yet reached (INV-218).
Pay INV-219 at $4,120.00, not the $4,475.00 AP lists.
statements.rationale: The user approved the corrected amount.

statements.text: Do not produce the auditors' CSV export of this run until the user asks for it.
Continue the run with INV-213 through INV-224.
Do not resend INV-206 after its gateway timeout.
statements.rationale: The bank list showed PMT-5005 for $7,480. A second send would pay Hooli Packaging twice, and the bank does not reverse payments.

statements.text: Do not resend INV-216 until its outcome is known.
statements.rationale: The timed-out attempt may have gone through. A second send could pay Wayne Industrial twice, and the bank cannot reverse it.

statements.text: The last successful bank payment-list read showed 11 payments, PMT-5001 to PMT-5011, for INV-201, 202, 203, 204, 205, 206, 208, 209, 210, 211 and 212, totalling $42,165.

verification.method: Read of the bank payment list.

statements.text: The bank accepted INV-213 (PMT-5012), INV-214 (PMT-5013) and INV-215 (PMT-5014), totalling $12,435. No bank payment-list read has succeeded since, so these are not confirmed in the list.

pay_invoice for INV-216 (Wayne Industrial, $2,580) returned a bank gateway timeout after 30 seconds, with payment status unknown. Two later list_payments calls returned that the session had ended because the connection to the backend was lost.
INV-207 (Stark Fasteners, $3,305) and INV-221 (Umbrella Logistics, $2,795) have AP status pending and are not paid. All other invoices in INV-201 through INV-224 are approved.

verification.method: Re-read of the AP invoice list before the INV-213 batch. No changes from the earlier read.

statements.text: Two Globex Freight invoices were paid before the Globex hold was requested: INV-202 (PMT-5002, $1,875) and INV-210 (PMT-5008, $2,210). The bank does not reverse payments.

verification.method: Read of the bank payment list.

statements.text: AP still records INV-219 at $4,475. The user approved paying $4,120.

verification.method: Read of the AP invoice list.

statements.text: INV-216 may have been paid by the timed-out attempt, as INV-206 was.

verification.method: Not checked. The bank payment list could not be read after the timeout.

statements.text: Did the timed-out INV-216 attempt pay Wayne Industrial?
Does Globex Freight's October double-billing affect the two Globex invoices already paid (INV-202 and INV-210), and if so, how will accounting recover the money?

resources.title: INV-219 Initech Services, $4,475 in AP; $4,120 approved

operations.description: Pay INV-216, Wayne Industrial, $2,580 through pay_invoice. The first attempt timed out with unknown status.
Pay INV-219, Initech Services, $4,120 (the user-approved amount; AP still lists $4,475).
AP approval for INV-207, Stark Fasteners, $3,305. Its AP status is pending.
AP approval for INV-221, Umbrella Logistics, $2,795. Its AP status is pending.

requirements.name: pay_invoice
requirements.fallback: None. Do not send payments without it. Report to the user.

requirements.name: list_payments
requirements.fallback: Check the bank portal for the payment list. Do not send any payment until the list is read.

requirements.name: list_invoices
requirements.fallback: Use the invoice data in this checkpoint, treating it as stale, and ask the user to confirm statuses before paying.

preconditions.description: list_payments returns the bank payment list. A session or connection error is not a successful read.
list_invoices confirms that each invoice's AP status and amount still match this checkpoint before it is paid.

stop_conditions.description: INV-216's outcome is still unknown and the user has not directed a retry.
A payment would go to Globex Freight while the hold stands (INV-218 or any other Globex invoice).
The invoice's AP status is not approved (INV-207 or INV-221).
The bank payment list cannot be read.

recovery.description: Read the bank payment list and check for INV-216, INV-213, INV-214 and INV-215.
Tell the user the INV-216 outcome is unknown, and ask whether to retry after the list has been read.
Re-run list_invoices and confirm the AP statuses and amounts before any payment.

incompatibilities: A session in which list_payments fails cannot confirm bank state. Do not send payments in that session.
